About Me

TURNING IDEAS INTO INTUITIVE DIGITAL EXPERIENCES

I’m Anjaly Shaju, a UI Designer with 4+ years of experience creating responsive web applications, mobile interfaces and intuitive enterprise products. My practice combines Figma design systems, wireframes, prototyping and front-end implementation.

My approach combines rigorous user research, meticulous wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping. I believe that great design is not just how something looks, but how effortlessly it works for the end user.
